page.layout: One page of running text, with one marginal note in the left margin beside the second paragraph. The running head is at the top, with the page number at its left. The right-hand edge shows part of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: periculo, in noua domo exstruenda; de jumento proximi errante, aut sub onere succumbente; de quacunque fraudis specie in ponderibus & mensuris vitanda; de terminis aut limitibus non movendis; de restitutione damnorum acceptorum & datorum; de nō alienandis hæreditarie possessionibus, vel terra absolute vendenda, sed facultatibus inter cognatos retinendis, neque extra familiam transferendis; de successionibus fœminarum in hæreditatem fratrum, his deficientibus; de officiis erga viduas, pupillos, peregrinos & advenas, de ope ferenda fratribus egenis; de non ferendis mendicis in Dei populo; de non fœnerando fratri pauperi; de mercede operarii sine procrastinatione solvenda; de manumissione servorum, & clementia vel humanitate erga illos usurpanda; de componendis litibus inter fratres exortis; de bono publico sarto[?] tectoque confervando; de non recipiendis in civium numerum Ægyptiis, Idumæis, Ammonitis & Amalekitis; de fœderibus cum idololatricis gentibus non feriundis.

Legum ha-rum usus.Ex quibus legibus liquidò apparet, consuetudinem, convictum & officia civilis vitæ placere Deo. Magnam etiam exercendæ dilectionis, amicitiæ, justitiæ, & plurimarum virtutum materiam filiis suis Deus exhibet, & arctissimo vinculo ipsos conglutinat quasi, & cōbinat, dum mutuo & reciproco jure, consilio & auxilio, ope & operâ ipsos sese sublevare vult. Quibus officiis non hominibus tantùm, & fratribus in Christo debitū præstatur dilectionis, sed Deus ipse mediatè coli-tur

page.notes: The word "sarto" (printed with a sign over the vowel, as "fartᵒ") is doubtful; the long s looks like f in this type. The marginal note is split across two lines by a hyphen ("ha-" / "rum"). The right-hand edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and was not transcribed.
